description.value: Quiznos is a toasted submarine sandwich chain founded in 1981 in Denver, CO, with this Chilliwack franchise occupying unit G120 in a commercial complex. It offers a broad menu of hot toasted subs, sliders, salads, and soups made with branded high-quality ingredients. For a touring cyclist passing through Chilliwack, it represents a quick, filling hot-food stop with multiple protein and vegetarian options.
